description: This source file defines a custom NSView subclass 'HoverChromeContainerView' which composes content with a chrome overlay, including drag and resize handles, and a close button, for use in a macOS application UI.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView
classes.description: A custom container view with chrome overlay, drag, resize, and close controls for macOS UI.

methods.name: init(containing:)
methods.description: Initializer that sets up the content and chrome views with constraints.

methods.name: updateTrackingAreas
methods.description: Overridden method to update mouse tracking areas for hover effects.

methods.name: mouseEntered
methods.description: Handles mouse enter events to fade in the chrome overlay.

methods.name: mouseExited
methods.description: Handles mouse exit events to fade out the chrome overlay.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Action method triggered when close button is clicked; calls the onClose callback.
